items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the Gysin map commutes with a flat pullback of the ambient scheme, on the level of cycles (statement lines 5302-5318, tag 02TP-adjacent). The proof reduces to an integral class, splits into the cases according to whether it is contained in the divisor, uses the identification of intersections as inverse images in the first case and the compatibility of the cap with flat pullback in the second, and extends to general cycles by the infinite sums statement. The two-case analysis is the substance, so the claim is H2.
